subject: CAIQ crosswalk & artifact delivery plan for Pinebridge onboarding
messages:
From: Ethan Rhodes <ethan.rhodes@pinebridge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Jill Tanaka <jill.tanaka@pinebridge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: CAIQ crosswalk & artifact request for onboarding

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for the intro call earlier — Pinebridge is ready to move to the technical review stage. We need a CAIQ crosswalk that maps Redwood controls to our vendor assessments and a short list of attachments we should expect (log samples, configuration screenshots, keystore proofing, etc.).

Can you send a plan and a deliverable list? Target: compliance intake by Aug 2 so our internal audit can start.

Also pls call out any items that require us to sign a data access or sample consent.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Rhodes
Senior IT Risk Manager | Pinebridge Financial
ethan.rhodes@pinebridge.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rhodes <ethan.rhodes@pinebridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 11:03:12 -0400
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk & artifact request for onboarding

Hi Ethan — thanks, this is clear.

Plan (high level):
- Scope confirm (tenant boundaries + runtime evidence scope) — action: Pinebridge to confirm whether they need tenant-level runtime logs or high-level routing diagrams.
- CAIQ crosswalk (we will map Redwood assertions to CSA/CAIQ controls and flag gaps) — deliverable: CAIQ_crosswalk_v0.xlsx (attached).
- Artifact list & owners — deliverable: artifact_checklist_v1.pdf (attached).
- Sample exchange & consent — we can provide anonymized runtime log samples; if Pinebridge wants raw token-level logs we will require a sample consent form and limited access window.
- Timeline: initial crosswalk + checklist by 07/22, samples in staging by 07/28, completed package by 08/01.

Attachments: prelim_caiq_crosswalk_v0.xlsx (workbook with initial mapping), artifact_checklist_v1.pdf

CCing Marissa (control owner liaison) and Priya (security engineering) — Marissa will coordinate evidence packaging; Priya will advise on log redaction.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Rhodes <ethan.rhodes@pinebridge.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:45:30 -04:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk & artifact request for onboarding

Morning team — adding a quick evidence choreography so Pinebridge knows owners and expected formats.

Artifact checklist (excerpt):
- Identity & Access Management: role mapping CSV (owner: Ben Carter)
- KMS/HSM proofs: key rotation log + KMS policy screenshot (owner: Priya Natarajan)
- Runtime telemetry: 7-day sample (anonymized) in .zip (owner: Hannah Schmitt)
- Network diagram + segment configs: PNG + config snippets (owner: Marissa Cole)

File formats: prefer PDF/XLSX for attestations, ZIP for logs. For runtime logs we will provide a redacted bundle and a separate manifest describing fields removed. If Pinebridge requires raw records we will issue a sample-consent template and propose a secure SFTP window.

Action items assigned:
- Pinebridge: confirm scope boundary (tenant vs org-level) and whether you require raw logs (Jill please advise).
- Redwood: we will put the crosswalk + initial artifacts into the shared Drive link and open a HubSpot task for weekly sync.

Attachments referenced: artifact_checklist_v1.pdf, prelim_caiq_crosswalk_v0.xlsx, runtime-log-sample-20270714.zip (staging bundle).

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Technical Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Jill Tanaka <jill.tanaka@pinebridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Ethan Rhodes <ethan.rhodes@pinebridge.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 14:20:05 -04:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk & artifact request for onboarding

Thanks Marissa — Pinebridge confirms tenant-level runtime logs are sufficient and we do not need raw token payloads. The redacted 7-day sample sounds fine.

One quick ask: can you include a short proof-of-possession note for KMS rotation (we need rotation timestamps and who approved the change). Also please include the network segment ID list (we'll match to our segmentation matrix).

We have an internal procurement step for sample access. I can sign your sample-consent template if you send it; otherwise we'll need a short legal note.

Thanks,
Jill
Jill Tanaka
Sourcing Manager | Pinebridge Financial
jill.tanaka@pinebridge.com

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 09:00:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ crosswalk & artifact request for onboarding — timeline and next steps

Thanks Jill — good to hear tenant-level logs are fine. Next steps and timeline: 

- Today (07/22): Redwood to publish CAIQ_crosswalk_v0 and artifact checklist to Drive (link below) and raise the HubSpot task (DEAL-1193).
- 07/23–07/26: Redwood owners collect artifacts; Priya will produce the redacted runtime bundle (runtime-log-sample-20270714.zip).
- 07/27: Hand-off in secure bucket/SFTP (we will provide access instructions and a one-week window).
- 07/28–08/01: Pinebridge to review and ask follow-ups; final package targeted 08/01.

Attached: prelim_caiq_crosswalk_v0.xlsx, artifact_checklist_v1.pdf, runtime-log-sample-20270714.zip (staging).

Please confirm you can accept SFTP access or if you prefer a signed consent via DocuSign — I can route a short consent template to you this afternoon.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2Bz-example-CAIQ-onboarding
HubSpot task: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-1193

Appreciate the quick turnaround — if Pinebridge confirms SFTP we will get the window open by Tuesday morning.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Sr. Manager, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
